# @loom/eval

Log-as-eval-fixture and LLM evaluation harness for Loom — replay a recorded event log deterministically, diff runs for golden-fixture regression, score outcomes, and run graded suites (exact, regex, JSON Schema, LLM judge via the decide scope) over cassette-recorded providers, with no live LLM/tool calls

## Entry points

- `@loom/eval`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
